intermediate.name: 5th passage of the finish line
intermediate.title: Sprint | 5th passage of the finish line (95.6 km)
Red Bull KM | via di San Gregorio (118.2 km)

story: Before the stage, the peloton visited the Vatican and received a blessing from the Pope. After a relaxed start with celebratory scenes, racing began on the local laps in Rome. A bunch sprint decided the stage, won by Olav Kooij, as Visma | Lease a Bike sealed both the stage victory and overall win with Yates.
